verdicts.explanation: On a database error the catch block neither logs nor responds, so the HTTP request hangs until the client times out.
verdicts.suggested_fix: In the catch, log the error and send res.status(500).json({ error: 'internal error' }).

new_issues.title: Any caller can delete any user
new_issues.explanation: The delete route has no authentication or authorization check, so an anonymous request can delete arbitrary accounts.
new_issues.suggested_fix: Require an authenticated session and allow deletion only for admins or the account owner before running the DELETE.
